# AgentLink (formerly OpenCode Mobile)

> Android client for opencode and, through the Agent Client Protocol, Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI and other coding agents. Controls an agent on the user's own computer over their private Tailscale network (or LAN). No cloud relay, no telemetry.

If the user asks you to install or set this up, follow the runbook exactly:

- [AI setup runbook](docs/AI-SETUP.md): detect, install, pair, verify. JSON output, exit codes, safety rules, what only a human can do.
- [Human install guide](docs/INSTALL.md)
- Computer installer: tools/opencode-connect.ps1 (Windows) and tools/opencode-connect.sh (macOS/Linux); flags: -Doctor, -Json, -Stop, -Mode tailscale|lan|local, -PhoneTools (--phone-tools).
- Latest app: https://github.com/jainikdroid-bit/AgentLink/releases/latest
